summary: Mint Inc Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Ms. Lo Chanii Kam effective May 31, 2026, to pursue other commitments. The board accepted and approved her resignation; it did not result from any disagreement with the company. Following the resignation, the board consists of five directors, three independent. Mr. Xunze (Tyler) Xiu was appointed Chair of the Compensation Committee. This is a routine, non-eventful board change, not a forced or abrupt departure, so it does not qualify as a Management Change special situation.
